inspiration.observed_pattern: A MySQL migration adds a textual column, updates it from an integer bitmask with MAKE_SET, and removes the old mask column.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a capability-label migration. An independently authored table receives a nullable summary column, UPDATE computes comma-delimited labels from fixed bitmasks with MAKE_SET, and the final projection checks zero, sparse, high, and NULL masks without copying the source schema, labels, or migration data.

fixture_notes: Target 410 has mask 0 and must produce an empty string; target 411 has mask 5 and must produce read,admin; target 412 has mask 18 and must produce write,export; target 413 has mask 31 and must produce all five labels; target 414 has a NULL mask and must remain NULL.
determinism_notes: Target IDs, masks, label arguments, and final ordering are fixed; the migration runs serially with no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules.
setup: CREATE TABLE deployment_capabilities (target_id INT PRIMARY KEY, target_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, capability_mask INT NULL, capability_summary VARCHAR(128) NULL)

INSERT INTO deployment_capabilities VALUES (410, 'zero-mask', 0, NULL), (411, 'sparse-read-admin', 5, NULL), (412, 'sparse-write-export', 18, NULL), (413, 'all-capabilities', 31, NULL), (414, 'unknown-mask', NULL, NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT target_id, target_name, capability_mask, capability_summary FROM deployment_capabilities ORDER BY target_id

checks.sql: SELECT target_id, capability_summary FROM deployment_capabilities WHERE capability_mask IS NULL OR capability_mask IN (0, 5, 18, 31) ORDER BY target_id
